lines.text: import { Button, Stack, storage, useTheme } from "@vitadeck/sdk";
blurb="storage keeps string pairs on disk for this Deck App (1 MiB). They survive a Deck App Runtime Restart and reinstalls; removing the Deck App deletes them."
To see it persist, press +1 a few times, open the Shell with Start (F1), activate another Deck App, then
VitaDeck Demo again and come back here.

type Repo = { full_name: string; description: string | null; stargazers_count: number; open_issues_count: number };
type RequestState = { status: "loading" } | { status: "done"; repo: Repo } | { status: "error"; message: string };
function isRepo(value: unknown): value is Repo {
if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return false;
const response = await fetch(REPO_URL, { headers: { Accept: "application/vnd.github+json" } });
if (!isRepo(body)) throw new Error("Unexpected response shape");
// Without this catch, a failed request (offline, DNS, TLS) would be an unhandled rejection and fail the Deck App.
if (!ignore) setRequest({ status: "error", message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
blurb={`fetch(url, init) returns a Promise of a response with status, headers, text() and json(). This section GETs ${REPO_URL} when it opens.`}
Offline? Connect the Vita to Wi-Fi and try again.
blurb="An uncaught error in render, an effect, a handler or a timer, or an unhandled promise rejection, replaces the Deck App with the Deck App Failure Screen."
throw new Error("Thrown on purpose by the VitaDeck Demo");
To recover, press Start (F1 on the desktop) to open the VitaDeck Shell, activate another Deck App, then VitaDeck
Demo again. That Deck App Runtime Restart clears the Failure Screen; Storage keeps its values.
